question: How many bank accounts did the Anti-Scam Centre freeze in 2020?
gt_answer: The Anti-Scam Centre froze more than 9,015 bank accounts in 2020.
Context: The Anti-Scam Centre (ASC) uses technology to track island-wide scam trends and make sense of the voluminous crime data that the centre processes every day. In 2020, the ASC received more than 11,190 reports involving losses of more than S$164.6 million. In the same period, the ASC froze more than 9,015 bank accounts and recovered 35% of the total amount scammed, or about S$57.6 million.
